Activity.description: Rev up your glamping stay with an exciting dirt-biking ride through scenic trails. With expert guidance and stunning views, it’s the perfect burst of outdoor adventure before you unwind in comfort.
Enjoy peaceful, guided nature walks through beautiful surroundings. Discover local wildlife, scenic paths, and quiet moments in nature—an easy, refreshing addition to your glamping stay.
Discover how to find edible plants and natural resources with our guided survival foraging experience. Learn essential skills, explore the landscape, and connect with nature in a whole new way.

Explore the wonders of the natural world with hands-on wildlife studies. Observe local animals in their habitats, learn from knowledgeable guides, and deepen your connection to nature during your glamping retreat.

Sharpen your navigation skills with our hands-on orienteering experience. Learn to read maps, use a compass, and explore the terrain as you find your way through nature’s pathways. A fun and engaging adventure for all skill levels.
